title: Uruguayan Provolone Wrap
description: A simple, savory wrap filled with sautéed provola and served with a side of aromatic sauce.
instructions: 1. Preheat a pan over medium heat.
2. Cube the provola cheese and add to the pan.
3. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheese is melted and slightly browned.
4. Warm the wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 10-15 seconds.
5. Spoon the provola mixture onto the center of the wrap.
7. Top with cubed dense bread, if using.
8. Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll into a tight cylinder.
